criteria.text: Run a reproducible, production-safe balanced benchmark with two repetitions per case: (1) compare z-ai/glm-5 with deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash on sales correctness, tool behavior, sales quality, and latency; (2) compare nex-agi/nex-n2-mini with deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash on structured JSON/schema correctness, semantic accuracy, helper task quality, tool arguments, reliability, and latency. Use synthetic/fixed evidence only, preserve blinded raw artifacts and scoring rules, select a winner for each route only when hard correctness gates pass, and do not change production routing without separate authorization.
